PB-STRIKE_PLAGUE_BRINGER.title: Strike
PB-DEFEND_PLAGUE_BRINGER.title: Defend
PB-INFECTED_SCALPEL.title: Infected Scalpel
PB-PLAGUE_VIAL.title: Plague Vial
PB-FUMIGATE.title: Fumigate
PB-QUARANTINE.title: Quarantine
PB-QUARANTINE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Apply {Sway:diff()} Sway to ALL enemies with [gold]Plague[/gold].
PB-INHALE_SPICES.title: Inhale Spices
PB-INHALE_SPICES.description: Choose one: Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to total [gold]Plague[/gold] on all enemies, or heal 10% of it, rounded up.
PB-INHALE_SPICES_BLOCK_CHOICE.title: Take Cover
PB-INHALE_SPICES_BLOCK_CHOICE.descriptio: Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to total [gold]Plague[/gold] on all enemies.
PB-INHALE_SPICES_HEAL_CHOICE.title: Inhale
PB-INHALE_SPICES_HEAL_CHOICE.description: Heal 10% of total [gold]Plague[/gold] on all enemies, rounded up.
PB-PANDEMIC.title: Pandemic
PB-PANDEMIC.description: Apply {Plague:diff()} [gold]Plague[/gold] to ALL enemies, then trigger [gold]Plague[/gold] on ALL enemies.
PB-PATIENT_ZERO.title: Patient Zero
PB-PESTILENCE.title: Pestilence
PB-SEPTIC_CUT.title: Septic Cut
PB-CONTAMINATED_GAUZE.title: Contaminated Gauze
PB-CONTAMINATED_GAUZE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Apply {Plague} [gold]Plague[/gold] to a random enemy.
PB-SYMPTOM_CHECK.title: Symptom Check
PB-SYMPTOM_CHECK.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If any enemy has [gold]Plague[/gold], draw 1 card.
PB-FLEA_BITE.title: Flea Bite
PB-FLEA_BITE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the target already has [gold]Plague[/gold], apply {Plague} [gold]Plague[/gold].
PB-CONCENTRATED_DOSE.title: Concentrated Dose
PB-MIASMA.title: Miasma
PB-MIASMA.description: At the start of your turn, apply {PlaguePerTurn} [gold]Plague[/gold] to ALL enemies.
PB-ISOLATION_WARD.title: Isolation Ward
PB-ISOLATION_WARD.description: The first time each turn you apply [gold]Plague[/gold] to an enemy, gain {BlockOnPlague:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
PB-INCUBATION.title: Incubation
PB-INCUBATION.description: Increase an enemy's [gold]Plague[/gold] by {Percent:diff()}%, rounded up.
PB-CROSS_CONTAMINATION.title: Cross Contamination
PB-CROSS_CONTAMINATION.description: Apply {Percent:diff()}% of the target's [gold]Plague[/gold], rounded up, to every other enemy.
PB-PESTILENT_BLOW.title: Pestilent Blow
PB-PESTILENT_CLOUD.title: Pestilent Cloud
PB-TERMINAL_DIAGNOSIS.title: Terminal Diagnosis
PB-TERMINAL_DIAGNOSIS.description:
Apply {Plague} [gold]Plague[/gold].
Then increase its [gold]Plague[/gold] by {Percent}%, rounded up.
PB-BLACK_TONIC.title: Black Tonic
PB-BLACK_TONIC.description:
Apply {SelfPlague} [gold]Plague[/gold] to yourself.
Gain {Energy:diff()} [gold]Energy[/gold]. Unspent Energy persists into your next turn.
PB-RELAPSE.title: Relapse
PB-RELAPSE.description: At the start of your turn, trigger [gold]Plague[/gold] on ALL enemies once for each Relapse.
PB-SEPTIC_JAB.title: Sample Extraction
PB-SEPTIC_JAB.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the target has [gold]Plague[/gold], gain {Specimen} Specimen.
PB-CENSER_HOOK.title: Censer Hook
PB-CENSER_HOOK.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the target already has [gold]Plague[/gold], apply {Plague:diff()} more.
PB-DRAIN_THE_WOUND.title: Drain the Wound
PB-DRAIN_THE_WOUND.description: Remove ALL [gold]Plague[/gold] from the target. Deal {Multiplier:diff()} times that much damage.
PB-SEPTIC_LANCE.title: Septic Lance
PB-CONTAGIOUS_CUT.title: Contagious Cut
PB-CONTAGIOUS_CUT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Apply {Plague:diff()} [gold]Plague[/gold] to ALL enemies.
PB-RUPTURING_BLOW.title: Rupturing Blow
PB-VIRULENT_CUTS.title: Virulent Cuts
PB-VIRULENT_CUTS.description: Whenever you deal unblocked Attack damage, apply {Plague:diff()} [gold]Plague[/gold] to the target.
PB-AIRBORNE_CULTURES.title: Airborne Cultures
PB-AIRBORNE_CULTURES.description: At the end of your turn, apply {Plague} [gold]Plague[/gold] to ALL enemies.
PB-CONTAGIOUS_RUPTURE.title: Contagious Rupture
PB-CONTAGIOUS_RUPTURE.description: Remove ALL [gold]Plague[/gold] from the target. Deal {Multiplier:diff()} times that much damage to ALL enemies.
PB-SEPTIC_EXECUTION.title: Septic Execution
PB-SEPTIC_EXECUTION.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Trigger the target's [gold]Plague[/gold] {Triggers:diff()} time(s).
PB-BLACK_LANCET.title: Black Lancet
PB-FINAL_INCISION.title: Final Incision
PB-MUTATION.title: Mutation
PB-MUTATION.description: At the start of your turn, increase [gold]Plague[/gold] on ALL enemies by {Percent:diff()}%, rounded up.
PB-LAST_PATIENT.title: Last Patient
PB-LAST_PATIENT.description: At the start of your turn, if no enemy has [gold]Plague[/gold], apply {Plague:diff()} [gold]Plague[/gold] to an enemy.
PB-CONTAGION_ENGINE.title: Contagion Engine
PB-CONTAGION_ENGINE.description: At the start of your turn, apply {Plague:diff()} [gold]Plague[/gold] to ALL enemies.
PB-CULTURE_TRANSFER.title: Culture Transfer
PB-EMERGENCY_PROCEDURE.title: Emergency Procedure
PB-PATHOLOGY_REPORT.title: Pathology Report
PB-PATHOLOGY_REPORT.description: Spend up to {SpecimenCap} Specimens. For each spent, draw 1 card and apply {PlaguePerSpecimen} [gold]Plague[/gold] to ALL enemies.
